criteria.evidence: The package installed from local archives and exercised its three public entries. The direct server tests covered management authority, CSRF checks, key metadata and exclusion from MCP.

Installed Chromium issued and rotated real fixture keys, exercised overlap and cutoff, canceled then confirmed named revocation, and verified the old and revoked credentials no longer authenticated. It checked cross-workspace and one-time secret boundaries.

The installed page discarded transient secret state and reconciled a committed write with a lost response through exactly one read and no write replay. The component also guarded pending and undisclosed secrets. Headless and UI bundles compiled.
